gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p5 prints Transfers in (out) per column: General (42,909), Street (15,641), Sales Tax -, Other Governmental Funds 58,550, Total '-'; JSON transfers_in 58,550 / transfers_out 58,550. Detail: General Fund departments combining statement pp14-15 Police 327,732 + Park 101,624 + Pool 30,903 + Library 66,006 + Cemetery 17,696 = 543,961 in, Administrative (571,870) + Fire (15,000) = (586,870) out (net (42,909) = statement General column); nonmajor p13 Civic Center 27,910 + Sinking 30,640 = 58,550 = statement Other Governmental column. Positive detail 543,961 + 58,550 = 602,511 vs 58,550: gap 543,961 = transfers between General Fund departments, printed gross on the departmental schedule and netted inside the General Fund column of the statement. All printed and correctly signed. No fix.

Same cause as transfers_in: detail out = Administrative (571,870) + Fire (15,000) (pp14) + Street Transfer out (15,641) (p11) = (602,511); statement out General (42,909) + Street (15,641) = (58,550) (p5). Gap 543,961 = the General Fund interdepartmental transfers (586,870 - 42,909 = 543,961) netted in the statement's General column. No fix.

No business-type schedule; the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position (p7) prints Electric, Water, Sewer and Trash Fund columns. JSON receipts = Consumer sales 4,303,364 + Other revenue 144,969 + Interest income 64,753 + Sale of assets 10,500 + Grants 1,768,407 = 6,291,993. Added: Electric 3,542,091 + 128,906 + 43,183 = 3,714,180; Water 442,967 + 12,567 + 18,230 + 1,768,407 = 2,242,171; Sewer 206,010 + 19 + 728 + 10,500 = 217,257; Trash 112,296 + 3,477 + 2,612 = 118,385. Total 6,291,993 (gap 0).
